svg.title: TYPE/262 architecture
svg.desc: Clients (web app app.html, which opens on Solana with a network switch, with the Unclaimed Board and domain profiles, read from Solana and Robinhood Chain; SDK lib/wallet262.js; CLI; MCP server for AI agents, which pays on Robinhood Chain) resolve domains over DNS-over-HTTPS from Cloudflare and Google, cross-checked, reading the WALLET record (type 262) or _wallet TXT "SOL <address>" in a DNSSEC-signed zone. On Solana mainnet a payer sends SOL or USDC straight to the published address. Every domain also has a vault, an HMAC-derived address anyone can send SOL, USDC or any SPL token to; on pump.fun coins launched with create_v2 and the vault as creator, every creator fee, on the bonding curve and on PumpSwap, accrues to it. The TYPE/262 worker (type262-upload.onrender.com) holds the vault keys, reads the SOL record from both resolvers with the DNSSEC AD bit, and pays the vault out to the published wallet minus a 0.5% fee; a sender can take a deposit back after 180 days if the domain has not claimed since. Also on Robinhood Chain (chain id 4663): DomainEscrow, DnssecVerifier with the ENS DNSSEC oracle anchored to the IANA root keys, DomainLauncher on pons v2, and the MCP server, in USDG and ETH.

g.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: AI agents pay on Robinhood Chain
DNSSEC turned on at your DNS host
No TYPE/262 server in the path
Anyone sends SOL, USDC, any SPL
The one SOL address in DNS
Proofs checked to the IANA root
AI agents pay in USDG or ETH
Solana mainnet · worker type262-upload.onrender.com · Robinhood Chain contracts verified on Sourcify
